violations.text: Establishment makes/bottles lemonade without prior approval from RIDOH. Establishment is to stop bottling lemonade until approval is given from RIDOH. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Per interview of PIC, chicken was placed hot and covered in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep. Chicken was uncovered and placed into the walk-in cooler at the time of inspection. Proper cooling methods reviewed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

The pizza prep area does not have a hand-washing sink that is conveniently located and/or readily accessible. Hand-washing sinks must be located to allow convenient use by employees in food preparation, food dispensing, and ware-washing areas. New Violation. Correct By: 05/13/2025
Hot water for 3 bay sink was not reaching temperature of 110F. New Violation. Correct By: 05/13/2025
